detail.longDescription: I am the owner and founder of TheGitAI Coding Agent. I built this Chrome extension to let the agent control your existing browser directly from the terminal without interrupting the workflow. It doesn't require your login details or any secrets. You can control your browser now through agent without sharing any credentials through UI. Each step is taken right in front of you with controllable permissions. Try it for your most complicated work that requires browser access. Would love to hear feedback!
